description: Curated 102.21 cases: HQ rulings that apply exactly one paragraph of the 102.21(c) hierarchy, state the country they reached, and state the production facts the paragraph turns on.
selection: Mechanical, then curated. Candidates are every HQ ruling citing 102.21 that applies exactly one (c) paragraph, is not multi-scenario, and states a holding country. Each was then read; those whose good's classification or production facts are not stated were dropped, and every remaining one was kept regardless of whether originshift agrees.
dropped: 561092 (decided under 19 CFR 12.130(c), not 102.21); 561954, 559899 (no single holding country — 'a Caribbean country'); 958964, 959417, 561967 (good's classification not stated); 559853 (several goods under one holding)
